articles.summary: We're excited to announce end-to-end content-defined chunking (CDC) support for Bazel remote caching in BuildBuddy.
articles.title: End-to-end CDC support

articles.summary: In addition to build logs, you can now use the bb CLI to stream bazel run executable output to our servers and view live-updating run logs from the UI.
articles.title: Run log streaming

articles.summary: BuildBuddy has supported passing short-lived secrets to remote actions via the env-overrides platform property, which redacts values from action cache entries. The new secret-env-overrides and secret-env-overrides-base64 properties extend this protection by also redacting values from workflow logs.
articles.title: Improved handling of short-lived secrets in remote execution
